summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT). Built machine learning inference systems end to end, cutting YOLO latency 5.2× (56.7 to 10.9 ms) with TensorRT and writing custom CUDA kernels with memory coalescing. Fine-tuned transformer models in PyTorch and Hugging Face, and built distributed systems on MPI (30× speedup on 55 processes) and a WebSocket pipeline across mobile, edge server and Jetson.

Tools: systemd service management (unit files, auto-restart, non-root isolation)

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via improved preprocessing and model tuning.
Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free visual document understanding transformer) on a custom medical billing dataset for structured field extraction.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Used GitLab for version control and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis and technical documentation.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated faster-whisper STT (1.0–1.4s), Gemini intent classification (<500ms), TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2× speedup: 56.7→10.9 ms, 17.6→92 FPS vs eager PyTorch) for visual servoing, and dual VL53L0X ToF sensors (25 mm gripper-triggered close, TCA9548A I2C mux).

Built a voice-controlled pick-and-place system over a three-layer distributed pipeline (Flutter client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, Jetson+Arduino controller) on a WebSocket fabric; resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture) for 100% pick reliability (10/10) at ~11.5s voice-to-picked latency.

Deployed the Jetson arm bridge as a systemd service (Type=simple, auto-restart with backoff, non-root isolation, environment-file config) with static IP networking; configured XRDP for remote administration.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Coalesced kernel ran at 49.2ms vs 73.3ms (uncoalesced) and 77.5ms (CPU TorchScript) — ~35% speedup over naive GPU with identical classification accuracy.

Replaced TorchScript conv layers in VGG16 with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing, constant memory for weights/biases, and preallocated global buffers to eliminate per-layer allocation overhead.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B; profiled peak VRAM and inference latency across prompt types using pynvml and psutil.
Benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC; <1% accuracy degradation with +0.09 perplexity increase — near-lossless compression.

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Language Model from Scratch
bullets: Implemented a GPT-2 style Transformer from scratch in PyTorch: multi-head self-attention, MLP blocks, residual connections, layer norm, and weight tying.

projects.name: Parallel Ray Tracer with MPI Task Scheduling
bullets: Implemented and benchmarked four parallel work distribution strategies (static strip/block/cyclic, dynamic task queue) for rendering 5000×5000 pixel scenes using MPI.
